# Stand Firm in the Gap
## Scripture
"Watch, stand fast in the faith, be brave, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul’s closing words to the Corinthians read like a battlefield commander’s final orders. He doesn’t tell us to attack, to charge, or to conquer—he tells us to *stand*. In a world that constantly pushes men to compromise, to blend in, or to retreat into passivity, standing firm is an act of war.

The original Greek for "be brave" literally means "play the man." It’s a call to step into the role God designed for you—not as a bully, but as a protector. To stand fast in the faith means your convictions have a backbone. It means your "yes" is solid, and your "no" is immovable.

Men, you don’t need a bigger platform; you need a firmer footing. Check your stance today. Are you anchored in Scripture, or are you swayed by the latest opinion? Are you praying with intensity, or just going through the motions? The enemy is looking for men who wobble. Decide today that you will not be one of them. Play the man. Hold the line. God has given you everything you need to stand.

## Daily Challenge
Find a wall and hold a plank for 60 seconds. As you shake, pray: "Lord, make my faith as unshakable as my body is right now."
